name: Signs With Key
description: A certificate authority signs with a private key held outside the backend: an AWS KMS key, a GCP KMS key or an HSM object. Target open for those three stores. Absent when the key is `software` (held in the backend) — read `key_storage` on the CA to tell absent-because-software from not observed.

key_state.description: `active` for the key that signs now; `additional_trusted` for a key kept trusted during rotation.
